module: Entry point of the Lua virtual machine "objectpool" (vmType = 'objectpool'), which stores serialized vehicle objects (lpack) in an `objPool` table keyed by object id. It is used to move vehicle data between VMs: the engine calls getObject, setObject, moveObject, deleteObject. It loads luaCore, utils, devUtils, ve_utils and mathlib, redefines `print` to the log and installs metatables on _G so that an object's global variables are stored in its record (objData).
notes: This is not an extension: it is the main.lua file of a separate VM, loaded by the engine; package.path is redefined and package.cpath is emptied.
After _setObj(objId, obj), any read or write of an unknown global goes through __indexHandler / __newIndexHandler and goes into objPool[objId] (rawget/rawset on objData).
float3 is an alias of vec3. The hooks onNodeCollision, onVehicleReset, onBeamBroke and onBeamDeformed are empty.
getObject and moveObject encode with lpack.encode; moveObject also removes the object from the pool. setObject and moveObject log via dump.

print.desc: Replaces print: writes to the log with level 'A' and tag 'print'. Only the first argument is converted (tostring(...)).

getObject.desc: Returns the pool object encoded as an lpack string, without removing it.

moveObject.desc: Returns the encoded object and removes it from the pool (transfer to another VM).

setObject.desc: Decodes an lpack string and stores it in the pool under objId.

deleteObject.desc: Removes the object from the pool.

initPool.desc: Initialization of the pool's "thread" VM; does nothing.

init.desc: Called in the object's Lua VM: decodes initData (lpack), loads the vehicle with jbeam/stage2 (loadVehicleStage2) and stores it in objPool[obj:getId()] = {v = object}. Logs an error and returns false (unloads the Lua) if the data is invalid.

initData.desc: spawn data encoded by lpack, with a vdata field

returns.desc: true if the object is loaded, false otherwise

onNodeCollision.desc: Node collision hook called by the engine; empty body in this VM.

onVehicleReset.desc: Hook called by the engine on a reset; empty body.

onBeamBroke.desc: Hook called by the engine when a beam breaks; empty body.

onBeamDeformed.desc: Hook called by the engine when a beam deforms; empty body.

_setObj.desc: Selects the current object: sets the globals obj, objectId and objData (= objPool[objId]) with rawset.

__newIndexHandler.desc: Metatable of _G: a global assignment is stored in objData instead of _G.

__indexHandler.desc: Metatable of _G: reading a missing global is looked up in objData.

returns.desc: value found in objData, or nil
